text: 美股三大指数涨跌不一，标普500指数涨0.12%，道指跌0.09%，纳指涨0.32%。大型科技股方面，超威半导体涨1.28%，Meta涨1.15%，SpaceX涨1.05%。中概股方面，京东跌1.11%，哔哩哔哩跌1.32%，携程跌2.23%，小鹏集团跌3.32%，理想汽车跌3.33%，蔚来跌4.32%。
text_en: The three major U.S. stock indexes closed mixed, with the S&P 500 up 0.12%, the Dow down 0.09%, and the Nasdaq up 0.32%. Among large technology stocks, Advanced Micro Devices rose 1.28%, Meta rose 1.15%, and SpaceX rose 1.05%. Among Chinese concept stocks, JD.com fell 1.11%, Bilibili fell 1.32%, Trip.com fell 2.23%, XPeng Group fell 3.32%, Li Auto fell 3.33%, and NIO fell 4.32%.
